items: A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable ID safety category.

Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the personal protective 
 equipment must used as safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc
Retighten the terminals in control cubicle
Clean the contacts of the main contactors using dry spray.

Connect the AC supply (380 Vac) to control cubicle of 
 the electrical valve.
Choose the mechanical valve of water by hand.

Simulate the protection signals for transformer 
 differential protection and bucholz protection cosequantly and observe the 
 operation of electrical valve of water.

After each protection signal, close the electric 
 valve by push button (close), on control cubicle.
Open the water mechanical valve by hand.

Open the mechanicl valve by push button (open & stop) 
 together.
Close the mechanical valve by push button (close).

Observe the alarm signal at local control board of 
 the unit.

Power Stations | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection 
 I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Zakaria 
 Mohamed Abdel-Rahem, tested by eng. Osama Ahmed Hasanen, accepted by eng. 
 Mahmoud Abdel-Daiem: general director at Aswan Dam 1 Power Station, approved 
 by eng. Khalaf Allah Mahmoud Abdel-Gaber: Head sector, and certified by 
 eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC quality control general director & MPIS 
 Coordinator
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable ID safety category.
Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the personal protective 
 equipment must used as safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc
Tools and Equipment
Digital ammeter
Screw Drivers
Digital ammeter
Screw Drivers
Jumpers
dry spray
Work to be Carried Out
Retighten the terminals in control cubicle
Clean the contacts of the main contactors using dry spray.
Connect the AC supply (380 Vac) to control cubicle of 
 the electrical valve.
Choose the mechanical valve of water by hand.
Simulate the protection signals for transformer 
 differential protection and bucholz protection cosequantly and observe the 
 operation of electrical valve of water.
After each protection signal, close the electric 
 valve by push button (close), on control cubicle.
Open the water mechanical valve by hand.
Open the mechanicl valve by push button (open & stop) 
 together.
Close the mechanical valve by push button (close).
Observe the alarm signal at local control board of 
 the unit.
